reviews.author: Eli Jenkins
reviews.text: Best experience I have had with a plumber. I had asked another company (big chain) for a quote on a very simple install/repair and it was for 4 times the cost of what Alpha and Omega did it for. He also came same day I called! He is honest, fun to talk to, and does fantastic work even reusing some parts to save me money. A great choice if you want great work at a fair price.

reviews.author: Kim Lingerfelt
reviews.text: We called on a Friday evening and we were able to get help. Very friendly and he was able to fix our new kitchen faucet! We appreciated his willingness to help us on such a short notice!!

reviews.author: Tommy Ritchie
reviews.text: Called on a Sunday for a leak. Dwayne was there in less than 30 minutes, and had the leak repaired shortly afterwards. He was very knowledgeable and provided excellent work and price.

reviews.author: Deborah Rogers
reviews.text: We had several plumbing issues and had not been able to get another plumber to respond back to us, so we tried Alpha & Omega. He came out promptly and fixed all our problems efficiently. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kevin Hartman
reviews.text: Had to call a plumber late in the evening after my attempts to fix the problem failed. Alpha and Omega Plumbing came right out and within a few minutes had the problem fixed. Thanks for coming out in the evening in a short amount of time. Did a fantastic job!

reviews.author: Donna Harmon
reviews.text: Love his work, reasonable priced . He fixed my plumbing with no problem. I recommend them 100 percent and he is fast. Thank you for fixing my water line in my kitchen.

reviews.author: Sheena Lee
reviews.text: I called Alpha & Omega Plumbing after my pipe burst, and another plumber left my job undone. I had no pipes under my double kitchen sink. He answered quickly and was here extremely fast. He installed new pipes in just a few minutes. The rate was very reasonable. Thank you for your understanding of my issue, being so kind, coming very fast, and getting everything back up and running. Outstanding!

reviews.author: Michael Benson
reviews.text: Highly recommend!! Needed someone on a Sunday at 7pm to fix a toilet. No one else answered but this guy did! Came out 30 mins after contact and had it fixed within 15 minutes. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Pamela Duncan
reviews.text: I called Dwayne this am to replace my toilet..he thought he had 1 in stock but he didn't have what I needed/wanted..he went over and beyond finding me 1 at a good price and was here this afternoon to install. Was quick installation..and made sure there was no leaks and everything worked properly...this makes bout the 7th or 8th time I've called Dwayne for different jobs..and has always been right here to help the same day.....thank u Dwayne...!! For the excellent service you always provide!

reviews.author: Kim Honeycutt
reviews.text: Needed a plumber to fix a leak in the main line coming into our home, ON A SATURDAY!! He returned my call promptly, was on time and quickly repaired the line at a reasonable rate. We will remember him when we have future plumbing issues.

reviews.author: MoJo Jordan
reviews.text: water bill showed I had a leak, Dwayne quoted $300 for the job (site unseen) and stayed within budget. same day service .. he earned every dollar, crawled under deck to access leak, completed the repair and explained exactly what he did. he will be my first call in the future.

reviews.author: Cynthia Lanning
reviews.text: Came out very quickly on a holiday and immediately fixed a rapid leak. Excellent work, super friendly. I highly recommend and will be using him for future needs.

reviews.author: Robin Gore
reviews.text: Quick and timely service. Very helpful and came out on short notice to repair a leak and got it fast. Told me his normal price up-front and ended up charging less after the job was done.

reviews.author: BOB Lester
reviews.text: The business owner came out after regular business hours to repair a broken faucet outside that a landscaper had hit with a Bobcat. Dwayne was extremely cordial and professional and helped resolve our concerns with the busted outside faucet on a relatively short notice!! We appreciate his work and arriving at the time he said that he would!! A +++++++++

reviews.author: Monica Morrison
reviews.text: Dewayne was awesome! Our shower head broke and we needed him right away! He came quickly, fixed a couple of other things and was quick about it! He was reasonably priced as well! Thank u Dewayne!!!!!!

reviews.author: Drew Jones
reviews.text: Service was courteous and professional, timely and every attempt was made to save us money and time. They even came out late on a Sunday to fix a leak. We highly recommend this company. Five stars.

reviews.author: Rebekah Conrad
reviews.text: Appreciated the willingness of the plumber to come after hours on a Friday night to fix our leaking bathtub faucet. Had all the necessary equipment and replacement parts to complete the job. Friendly and knowledgeable!

reviews.author: misty bjers
reviews.text: He came out very fast (on a Saturday too) and was efficient. He even took the time to explain some mechanical things as well. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Colleen Kappes
reviews.text: Called Dwayne this morning. He came early afternoon and fixed my leaking faucet. Very friendly, experienced and prompt. I will hire him again.

reviews.author: Ruth Hester
reviews.text: We have used Dewayne before and he is always very professional and tries to give us every discount available. His work is excellent. Thank you.

reviews.author: Charles Freeman
reviews.text: Called on a Sunday afternoon after a diy project went wrong. He was there within a few hours, reasonably priced as well. Keeping him on speed dial, would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Gerald Bosch (Teacherguy)
reviews.text: Discovered a leak when I got home from work and he was here in about two hours. He have me all the details about what was going on and finished the job quickly. Fast and friendly service.

reviews.author: Josh Kincaid
reviews.text: Came same day and had me running in no time. Great service! I highly recommend this company to anyone that wants great work done for a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: KRA
reviews.text: I called for emergency service and he came right away. Quick and Professional repair and a fabulous human being. I am so happy we met and will call no one else for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: TIffany Young
reviews.text: We've had him help us 3 times now. He is very helpful and honest. He has come later in the evening and helped us when we were in a huge bind. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Boog Hill
reviews.text: Did a great job, Has been to my house a few times over the years, always good work and price. Nice guy

reviews.author: Rah Sheen
reviews.text: Alpha and omega was just what the plumbing doctor ordered. He was very knowledgeable and knew the system type from years of experience. He is my new goto in davidson county.

reviews.author: B Wishon
reviews.text: Had a busted pipe at 8pm. Came within hour .Fixed 3 leaks in crawlspace. Very efficient and professional

reviews.author: Kimberly Berrier
reviews.text: Great friendly service! Toilet was leaking and he tried and changed everything over and over till he got it fixed. Doesn't stop till the job is done! Wonderful service!

reviews.author: John Weaver
reviews.text: Awesome work, and a very quick response. Very reasonable price and very nice to talk too. Would recommend anyone to use this business. Thank's again!

reviews.author: Michael Hargis
reviews.text: This man was here in no time on a Saturday night at that. Was fast, polite and very affordable. This is most definitely the man to call. Thanks again

reviews.author: Amanda Hayes-Rheuark
reviews.text: Fast service and quality work. I would absolutely use this business again for additional plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Roseanna Miles-Beckom
reviews.text: Showed up quickly, did a full inspection, diagnosed and repaired all in less than an hour. Highly reccomended!

reviews.author: LeeAnn
reviews.text: They answered their phone! Very knowledgeable, very courteous and did a great job. Can't ask for more!

reviews.author: ian tobin
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing to work with, fast (like really fast), professional, and friendly. I can not recommend them highly enough. They fixed my water the same day I messed it up and didn't charge an insane amount. 10/10
